title: ROGII Wellbore Geology Prediction — approach map

competition.description: Predict true vertical thickness/depth (TVT) along horizontal wellbores; Kaggle evaluates row-weighted RMSE, so long hidden tails carry more weight.
competition.prediction_target: Submit id,tvt predictions for the hidden tails of horizontal wellbores, conditioning on drilling/log data, typewell curves, and each well's visible TVT prefix.
competition.models: Target-free geosteering stack: particle-filter, beam-search, and DTW geological anchors; LightGBM/CatBoost/Ridge residual learners; model-package predictions and visible-prefix calibration.
competition.standing: Finished. Best recorded public draw: 6.435 (submission 55170737). Private score: Not recorded. Final rank: 753 / 6,063 recorded teams.
competition.lesson: A grouped-by-well and masked-prefix screen is essential: a near-perfect visible-prefix overlap shortcut scored 9.565 on hidden data, while a clean GS1.30 particle-filter draw reached 6.435. Scores are empirical draws because grading re-executes unseeded PF features.

nodes.title: Early neural / dual-PF baseline
nodes.summary: PyTorch NN starter scored 15.744; the later triple-signal beam-search + dual PF + LightGBM baseline scored 11.107.

nodes.title: Target-free geosteering rebuild
nodes.summary: Adopted the public PF/beam/DTW anchor plus residual-learner lineage. The contact-gated overlap override was initially enabled.

nodes.title: Disable contact override
nodes.summary: One-line no-override ablation exposed that near-perfect reconstruction of placeholder prefixes overfit the hidden grading data.

nodes.title: GS1.30 PF likelihood widening
nodes.summary: Multiplied the PF gamma-ray likelihood sigma by 1.3 on the vp_balanced_modelpkg_005 stack; three reproducibility draws formed a tight band.

nodes.title: Clean GS1.30 fork
nodes.summary: Removed the Q0522 hard-coded placeholder-data mutation, retaining the otherwise successful GS1.30 lineage.

nodes.title: Clean GS1.30 seeded offset +4000 (s4000)
nodes.summary: Best recorded account draw. It is a preserved final-submission candidate, not proof that +4000 is intrinsically superior under PF randomness.

nodes.title: Model-package-only prediction
nodes.summary: Pure pretrained model-package/TabICL output initially beat the sweep, but identical kernel/version reruns later produced 20.067 and an exception.

nodes.title: Component sweep: learned branch and PF anchor
nodes.summary: The pure LightGBM/CatBoost learned branch was weaker; the pure PF/ridge anchor twice failed at grading despite valid interactive outputs.
nodes.score: Learned branch public 7.856; PF anchor: platform grading exception twice

nodes.title: Model-package + no-override ensemble
nodes.summary: Averaged two near-tied but row-wise different candidates. The merge was verified by id, yet the one scored draw regressed badly.

nodes.title: GR denoising: median-7 and FFT-notch
nodes.summary: Both isolated tracker-path probes regressed: centered rolling-median (window 7) and dominant-frequency FFT notch.

nodes.title: Neighbor-well curve transfer
nodes.summary: A locally validated detrended-wiggle transfer found close neighbours, but v1 twice failed at grading and defensive v2 also failed; a stacked seed hedge scored 13.011.
nodes.score: Platform grading exceptions; stacked branch-hedge public 13.011

nodes.title: Physics-notebook ensemble candidate audit
nodes.summary: Static source comparison found the apparent 6.505 alternative was not independent: it matched clean GS1.30 functions and retained the hard-coded Q0522 mutation.
nodes.score: Not submitted; source fork had public 6.505

nodes.title: Azimuth-conditioned learned model
nodes.summary: Paired 196-feature control versus 200-feature conditioned models on five whole-well folds showed no credible improvement.

nodes.title: Direction-gated lateral self-alignment
nodes.summary: Masked-prefix screen over 60 wells and three fractions failed integration gates; permissive correlation gating caused severe regression.
nodes.score: Not submitted; strict pooled gain +0.0259 ft, bootstrap CI [-0.1995, +0.2700]
